triggers.name: new_charge
triggers.title: New charge
triggers.help: Picks up new charges created in Stripe in real-time. Only works on Stripe OAuth connections.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get charges created since the given date/time. Leave empty to get the charges created 1 hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Stripe action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Stripe connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: amount
input.label: Amount
input.hint: A positive integer in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a 0-decimal currency)

input.name: capture
input.label: Capture
input.hint: Whether or not to immediately capture the charge. Default is true

input.name: currency
input.label: Currency
input.hint: 3-letter ISO code for currency.

input.name: customer
input.label: Customer ID
input.hint: Click on 'Customers' and select the required customer. ID is at the end of URL. The customer who will be charged in this request. Either customer or source must be specified

properties.name: amount
properties.label: Amount
properties.hint: The amount to transfer to the destination account without creating an Application Fee. Cannot be combined with the application fee parameter. Must be equal to or lesser than the charge amount

input.name: on_behalf_of
input.label: On behalf of
input.hint: The Stripe account ID that these funds are intended for. Automatically set if you use the destination parameter

input.name: receipt_email
input.label: Receipt email
input.hint: The email address to send this charge's receipt to. The receipt will not be sent until the charge is paid.

input.name: statement_descriptor
input.label: Statement descriptor
input.hint: An arbitrary string to be displayed on your customer's credit card statement. This may be up to 22 characters

input.name: transfer_group
input.label: Transfer group
input.hint: A string that identifies this transaction as part of a group
